entry.title: Untangle a process
entry.use_when: See the steps—and where things get stuck.
entry.freshness: Review after failed use or a source/contract change.
entry.limitations: A prompt and artifact contract; requires an existing assistant or human practitioner.

pattern.activation: a process is confusing, a handoff keeps failing or nobody has a shared picture of the actual steps.

use_cases.title: Trace where one case gets stuck
use_cases.outcome: A current-state map separating observed steps, assumptions, waits and exceptions.

links.why: Mapping follows the work through steps; evidence search checks the documents and decisions behind uncertain steps.
